altText: Taylor Swift photo: Taylor Swift Eras Tour
body:
she's performing at the CMAs tonight and i genuinely cannot sit still 😭

the last time she sang on that stage was 2013, a stripped-down "Red" with Alison Krauss, Vince Gill, Sam Bush, Edgar Meyer and Eric Darken. i have rewatched it more times than i will admit.

and "I Knew It, I Knew You" is up for Single of the Year, so i'm holding my breath for that one too 🥹

8pm ET on ABC and Disney+, live from Nashville. see you on the couch.

📷 jurvetson (CC BY 2.0), via Openverse

why: Nov 18 CMA pre-show beat, IG half: feeling first, then the 2013 "Red" callback and the Single of the Year nomination, then when to watch. Sourced: GMA (2026-11-13) and Showbiz Junkies report Taylor performing at the 60th CMA Awards, Wed Nov 18, 8pm ET on ABC and Disney+ from Bridgestone Arena; last CMA performance 2013 ("Red" with Alison Krauss, Vince Gill et al.); nominated Single of the Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You". Intake #6840 was the lead only. No CMA moment in the Vault yet (#6891), so the era link. Pre-show only: no setlist, no performance described.

critique.rationale: Opens on the can't-sit-still feeling hours before her first CMA performance in 13 years, then the 2013 acoustic "Red" lineup and her Single of the Year nod. Every fact is checkable and the post expires tonight.
